S.FORM: ka-kuma'en-an ni ofad t-u 'epah k-u luma aku.
S.PHON: kak[o|u]maʔənan ni [o|u]fa[ɬ|ɮ] t[o|u] ʔəpaħ k[o|u] ɾ[o|u]ma ak[o|u]
S.FORM: kakoma^enan ni ofad to ^epah ko loma ako.
S.PHON: kak[o|u]maʔənan ni [o|u]fa[ɬ|ɮ] t[o|u] ʔəpaħ k[o|u] ɾ[o|u]ma ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: My place is where Ofad drinks (wine).

S.FORM: mi-cikay-an ni ofad i pitilidan k-u cudad.
S.PHON: miʦikajan ni [o|u]fa[ɬ|ɮ] i pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an k[o|u] ʦ[o|u][ɬ|ɮ]a[ɬ|ɮ]
S.FORM: micikayan ni ofad i pitilidan ko codad.
S.PHON: miʦikajan ni [o|u]fa[ɬ|ɮ] i pitiɾi[ɬ|ɮ]an k[o|u] ʦ[o|u][ɬ|ɮ]a[ɬ|ɮ]
S.TRANSL: Ofad runs to school to get the book.
Ofad runs to school for the book.
The book is what Ofad runs to school to get.

S.FORM: sa-ka-kuma'en ni ofad t-u futing k-u alapit.
S.PHON: sakak[o|u]maʔən ni [o|u]fa[ɬ|ɮ] t[o|u] f[o|u]tiŋ k[o|u] aɾapit
S.FORM: sakakoma^en ni ofad to foting ko alapit.
S.PHON: sakak[o|u]maʔən ni [o|u]fa[ɬ|ɮ] t[o|u] f[o|u]tiŋ k[o|u] aɾapit
S.TRANSL: Ofad eats fish with the chopsticks.
The chopsticks are what Ofad uses to eat fish.

S.TRANSL: Where do you pack the clothes?
How much money does Ofad want?
How much money does Ofad take?
How many children will you chase?

S.FORM: pina k-u mi-ala-an ni utay a payci?
S.PHON: pina k[o|u] miaɾaan ni [o|u]taj a pajʦi
S.FORM: pina ko mialaan ni otay a payci?
S.PHON: pina k[o|u] miaɾaan ni [o|u]taj a pajʦi
S.TRANSL: How much money did Utay take?
The money that Utay took is how much?

S.FORM: icuwaay a wacu k-u ka-ulah-an isu?
S.PHON: iʦ[o|u]waaj a waʦ[o|u] k[o|u] ka[o|u]ɾaħan is[o|u]
S.FORM: icowaay a waco ko kaolahan iso?
S.PHON: iʦ[o|u]waaj a waʦ[o|u] k[o|u] ka[o|u]ɾaħan is[o|u]
S.TRANSL: What you like is which dog?

S.FORM: nima a wacu k-u mi-kalat-ay t-u pusi aku?
